visual.general_description: Flow cytometry scattergram of side fluorescence versus side scatter with labelled cell populations including a high fluorescence region.
visual.detailed_description: Black-background scatter plot with a magenta L-shaped axis frame. The vertical axis is labelled "SFL" at the top left and the horizontal axis "SSC" at the bottom right; tick marks are present on both axes but no tick numbers are printed. Dots are colored by population and each region carries a white printed label. At the top is a blue band labelled "Macrophages/HF-cells" in the highest fluorescence zone, cut off by a sharp horizontal lower edge. Below it a broad diffuse green cloud labelled "Monocytes" extends from the upper middle toward the lower left. A dense bright-green cluster labelled "Lymphocytes" sits at the lower left. At the bottom center a dense cyan cluster is labelled "Neutrophils" and a smaller cyan cluster to its lower right is labelled "Eosinophils". No numeric counts, gate percentages, patient text or dates are printed.

visual.general_description: Six-panel light microscopy figure of stained pericardial fluid cytology.
visual.detailed_description: A six-panel grid of Giemsa-type stained cytology micrographs in three rows of two. Panels A and B (top row) are low-power views of clustered purple cells on a pale background. Panels C to F (lower two rows) are high-power views of large cells with big round violet nuclei and blue-purple cytoplasm among many small multilobed cells with segmented nuclei. Each panel carries a white panel letter at the upper left; no scale bars or other text.
